paper_role: child execution contract for the common P4b training schedule; it does not authorize a full scientific fit

schedule.epoch_numbers: 1 through 40; epoch zero is checkpoint evaluation only
schedule.batches_per_epoch: one global B=max over all outer-fold fit cells of ceil(fit trial rows/16)
schedule.sampling_unit: normalized-text identity uniformly within each task-by-pseudo cell
schedule.row_policy: least-used trial within the selected cell and normalized-text identity
schedule.counter_scope: cumulative across all 40 epochs separately for each outer-fold and seed
schedule.identity_selection: assign floor-or-ceiling equal full-schedule identity quotas per cell, then factor the remaining quota multigraph one batch at a time with deterministic bipartite b-matching; every identity whose global residual quota equals the number of residual batches is mandatory in the current matching
schedule.future_feasibility_invariant: before each batch every cell residual sum equals 16R and every global normalized-text residual sum is at most R, where R is the number of batches remaining including the current batch
schedule.row_order: seeded SHA256 permutation after cell-balanced selection
schedule.identity_exposure_requirement: within each outer-fold, seed and cell, maximum minus minimum normalized-text use count is at most one
schedule.row_exposure_requirement: within each outer-fold, seed, cell and normalized-text identity, maximum minus minimum trial-row use count is at most one
schedule.coverage_requirement: every fit trial row appears at least once in every outer-fold and seed schedule

output.unit_order: outer fold ascending, then training seed in frozen contract order

optimization.loss: symmetric cosine cross entropy with frozen arm-specific masks

randomness.hash_serialization: UTF-8 fields joined with ASCII unit separator 0x1f
randomness.initialization_seed: first 16 hexadecimal digits of SHA256(p4b-adapter-init-v1, outer_fold, training_seed), masked to a nonnegative signed 63-bit integer
randomness.initialization_scope: one byte-identical initial state shared by all three arms within each outer-fold and training-seed unit
randomness.global_mask_key: lowercase SHA256 hex of (p4b-global-mask-key-v1, 2026071806, schedule_contract_sha256, schedule_unit_sha256, outer_fold, training_seed, epoch, zero-based batch_index)

checkpoint.metric: macro mean of NR and TSR MRR on the outer-fold checkpoint partition
checkpoint.selection: strictly greater floating-point metric replaces the incumbent

bootstrap.replicate_seed: first 16 hex digits of SHA256(base seed, endpoint id, reference id, cluster id) interpreted as an unsigned integer
bootstrap.point_estimator: equal mean of NR and TSR per-trial means over all five fixed outer folds
bootstrap.cluster_multiplicity: sample the global unique cluster labels with replacement; share one multiplicity vector across all fixed strata
bootstrap.two_way_multiplicity: product of independently sampled global subject and normalized-text multiplicities
bootstrap.empty_stratum_policy: reject and redraw the replicate, at most 1000 attempts
